Name: Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes
Author: rjgilber
Description:
All crops and recipes are working in my game. Please let me know if you have any problems!

This mod adds 54 new field crops, 68 new trees, and over 300 recipes!

The trees and crops have been converted from my old JSON mods, as well as some of the recipes. Most of the recipes are new releases. Some of the sprites have been redone to make them prettier!

This mod should not conflict with any other crop or recipe mod.

To install, simply download, unzip and drop into your mod folder.

I hope you enjoy!

Fellow modders: Please feel free to post your on retextures or translations, and to use these materials in mods of your own. I can also add translations to the base mod if you want to send them to me. I used an i18n file that could be used as a base for translation mods! I just ask you give me credit and drop me a note when you post your mod so I can see what you've done!

[b]Work in Progress:[/b]
* Revising values to make health and energy more reasonable, and adding buffs
* Continuing to revise some sprites that aren't yet as pretty as I would like

[b]Change Log:[/b]
2.1.5: Fixed mung bean so it regrows as it says in its description. Added additional context tags consistent with other crop mods. Fixed two flipped recipe sprites.
2.1.3: Bug fixes as helpfully pointed out in the comments! Corrected Khajar Imli to Khajur Imli and Dadar Kulung to Dadar Gulung. Fixed issue that prevented Wattleseed tree from planting. Minor other typo fixes.
